name: xbrain-virtual-office
description: XBrain Virtual Office — Connect • Work • Collaborate. 3D multiplayer virtual office (React Three Fiber + Colyseus + LiveKit).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @xbrain/server" "npm run dev -w @xbrain/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @xbrain/web && npm run build -w @xbrain/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @xbrain/shared && npm run typecheck -w @xbrain/server && npm run typecheck -w @xbrain/web
